subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should #92201 remain the canonical umbrella until the Anthropic replay-prevention policy lands, or should maintainers hand off the remaining work to #94228/#99382 now that the recovery-carrier fixes landed?
rationale: The recovery half is on main, but the remaining prevention choice changes Anthropic thinking replay semantics and has open PRs with compatibility, provider, and message-delivery risk.

options.title: Keep #92201 As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Hand Off To Focused Issue
options.body: Make #94228 or #99382 the canonical remaining prevention tracker and close #92201 only after posting a clear handoff.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as the near-term resolution and defer signed-thinking replay policy to a later provider review.

recommendation.title: Keep #92201 As Umbrella
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.
